title: 系統級封裝異質整合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入功能分割、異質接口與系統驗證。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore functional partitioning, heterogeneous interfaces and system validation, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 系統分工
stages.description: 針對系統分工完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for system partition, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 功能需求樹｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Functional requirement tree | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對功能需求樹，把「系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For functional requirement tree, turn "System performance must become measurable module interfaces." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「功能需求樹」的模型：系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for functional requirement tree: System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付功能需求樹的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for functional requirement tree, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 功能需求樹：機制
knowledge.text: 系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。
knowledge.textEn: System performance must become measurable module interfaces.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 必須排除的錯判：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「系統級封裝異質整合」的「功能需求樹｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Functional requirement tree | mechanism and design” in “System-in-package heterogeneous integration”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「功能需求樹」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For functional requirement tree — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。
把功能元件放一起即成完整系統
各元件單獨熱測通過即可
optionsEn: System performance must become measurable module interfaces.
Equating colocated components with a complete system
Relying only on individual thermal passes
quiz.explanation: 系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 因此不能採用「把功能元件放一起即成完整系統」。
quiz.explanationEn: System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Therefore reject: Equating colocated components with a complete system.

steps.title: 功能需求樹｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Functional requirement tree | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對功能需求樹，把「系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For functional requirement tree, turn "System performance must become measurable module interfaces." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 將「把功能元件放一起即成完整系統」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating colocated components with a complete system" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付功能需求樹的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for functional requirement tree: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 晶粒技術分工｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Die technology partition | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對晶粒技術分工，把「不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For die technology partition, turn "Process-node benefits must offset packaging-interface costs." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「晶粒技術分工」的模型：不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「比較單晶片與多晶粒的完整預算。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for die technology partition: Process-node benefits must offset packaging-interface costs. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Compare complete monolithic and multichip budgets. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 比較單晶片與多晶粒的完整預算。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Compare complete monolithic and multichip budgets. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：分割越多一定越省成本。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming more partitioning always lowers cost. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付晶粒技術分工的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for die technology partition, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

options: 分割越多一定越省成本
金屬罩能消除全部電源耦合
不同製程的優勢須抵銷封裝接口成本。

Assuming a shield eliminates all power coupling

quiz.explanationEn: Process-node benefits must offset packaging-interface costs. Compare complete monolithic and multichip budgets. Therefore reject: Assuming more partitioning always lowers cost.

steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating a shared protocol name with interoperability. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接口契約的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for interface contracts: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 接口契約：機制
knowledge.text: 電壓、時序、阻抗、協定和測試要求都需一致。
knowledge.textEn: Voltage, timing, impedance, protocol and test contracts must agree.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 列雙方責任和版本。 必須排除的錯判：協定名稱相同即保證互通。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: List ownership and versions. Misinterpretation to reject: Equating a shared protocol name with interoperability. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「接口契約」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For interface contracts — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 協定名稱相同即保證互通
元件全固定好就不需應力分析
optionsEn: Equating a shared protocol name with interoperability
Skipping stress analysis after mechanical fixation
quiz.explanation: 電壓、時序、阻抗、協定和測試要求都需一致。 列雙方責任和版本。 因此不能採用「協定名稱相同即保證互通」。
quiz.explanationEn: Voltage, timing, impedance, protocol and test contracts must agree. List ownership and versions. Therefore reject: Equating a shared protocol name with interoperability.
